entities.name: Thomas M. Cooley
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas McIntyre Cooley was an American jurist who served on the Michigan Supreme Court from 1864 to 1885, presiding as its Chief Justice for his final year. He also served as the first chairman of the Interstate Commerce Commission.
